subject: Autism Acceptance and Caregiver Support
overview: Guest speaker Heather McKinnon delivered a presentation for Autism Acceptance Month on parenting a child on the autism spectrum, inclusion, and caregiver support resources. Attendees discussed their experiences navigating diagnoses and school services, followed by an inquiry on senior graduation procedures for out-of-district students.

items.title: Presentation on Autism Acceptance and Caregiver Experiences
items.summary: Heather McKinnon presented on raising a child on the autism spectrum, detailing early intervention, the transition to school inclusion programs, and the role of peer support groups for caregivers.

items.title: Parent Discussion on Diagnosis and Inclusion
items.summary: Caregivers discussed their experiences navigating autism diagnoses, educational inclusion, behavioral tracking, and connecting with community support networks.

items.title: Chapters Coffee Carts and Caregiver Self-Care
items.summary: McKinnon highlighted Chapters Coffee Carts, an upcoming supported worksite for disabled adults at the Medford Public Library, and shared self-care strategies for parents.

items.title: Information on Senior Activities and Graduation Participation
items.summary: Staff confirmed that out-of-district seniors are entitled to participate in Medford High School senior activities and graduation ceremonies with accommodations.
